effects.text: DON!! x1: When one of your opponent's Characters is removed from the field, give this Leader +1000 power until the end of your next turn.
Under the rules of the game, you may play up to 1 cost 1 [Zangetsu] Stage card at the beginning of the game.
Once Per Turn: If your Opponent deals damage, play up to 1 [Zangetsu] stage with a cost higher than the current one, by 1 from your deck. Then, shuffle your deck.
Start of Your Turn: Look at 3 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 [Parfum] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest on the top or bottom of your deck in any order.

Under the rules of this game, you can have up to 6 copies of any "Deadly Sentencing" type event cards in your deck. Additionally, if you have 7 or less DON!! cards in your field, you cannot activate event cards that are cost 7 or higher from your trash.
On Your Opponent's Attack Twice Per Turn: Activate an event card with a Counter from your trash. Then, draw 1 trash 1.
Once Per Turn: When you play a character, if it wasn't played from your hand, draw 2 cards, then trash 1 card. Then, this Leader gains +1000 power until the end of your opponent's next End Phase.
Activate: Main Once Per Turn: You may K.O. 2 of your {Land of Wano} type Characters: Add up to 1 card from your hand to the top of your Life cards.
All characters you play are played as rested.
When Attacking: You may rest 4 of your DON!! cards: Set up to 1 of your Characters with a cost of 6 or less as active.
Activate: Main Once Per Turn: Give 1 of your rested Characters Rush until the end of the turn.
Activate: Any Once Per Game: Return the game state to the last set checkpoint.
When Attacking: You may place one of your life cards other than the top card at the top of your Life area: this Leader gains +1000 power until the end of this turn.

DON!! x2 Activate: Main / When Opponent Attacks Once Per Turn: You and your opponent each trash the top 2 cards of your deck: Choose one: Your Turn: Give up to 2 rested DON!! cards to 1 of your Characters. Opponent's Turn: Give up to 1 of your opponent's Leaders or Character cards -2000 power during this battle.
Under the rules of this game, your deck consists of 40 cards and you cannot return cards from your trash to your deck by effects.
When Attacking: You may trash 1 card from the top of your deck: Up to 1 of your {Holy Knight} type Characters gains Rush and +1000 power until the end of your opponent's next End Phase.
